purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The Egyptian Survey Authority has a Dakahlia Survey Directorate with a Mansoura-specific public surveying/expropriation notice. The notice says maps and compensation lists are displayed at the local directorate and East Mansoura district office. This establishes a local survey-record source, but not an anonymous parcel GIS or the national urban real-property register: ESA lists its initial register rollout for nine Cairo areas, not Mansoura. No full parcel polygons were retained.
